q-2761.name: Question 1
q-2761.worked_solution:
First, we write the expression as a difference of squares:

$$
\begin{aligned}16{a}^{2}-81 & =(4a)^{2}-{9}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we factor the expression using the difference of squares formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}(4a)^{2}-{9}^{2} & =(4a+9)(4a-9)\end{aligned}
$$

q-2761.html:
Question 1
?

Factor the expression 16a2−81.

a
(2a−3)(2a−3)
b
(4a−9)(4a−9)
c
(4a+9)(4a+9)
d
(2a−3)(2a+3)
e
(4a−9)(4a+9)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we write the expression as a difference of squares: 16a2−81=(4a)2−92

Then, we factor the expression using the difference of squares formula: (4a)2−92=(4a+9)(4a−9)

q-2833.name: Question 2
q-2833.problem: Express $4{e}^{2}-16{f}^{2}$ as a product of two binomials.
q-2833.worked_solution:
We factor the expression using the difference of squares formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}4{e}^{2}-16{f}^{2} & = \\ (2e)^{2}-(4f)^{2} & = \\ (2e-4f)(2e+4f) & \end{aligned}
$$

(9−x)2

(x−9)(x+9)
c
(18−x)(18+x)
d
(9+x)2
e
(9−x)(9+x)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we write the expression as a difference of squares: 81−x2=92−x2

Then, we factor the expression using the difference of squares formula: 92−x2=(9−x)(9+x)
